selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train: python train_pancoll.py --model MutInf-in --dataset qb --device cuda:0 --max_hours 48 --eval_every 2000 --skip S_MS --tag _skipS_MS --results_dir results_panbase
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method MutInf --arm s_ms --train-set qb --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MutInf/s_ms/qb_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method MutInf --arm s_ms --train-set qb --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MutInf/s_ms/qb_full
runtime_note: upstream code calls .cuda(); the released code leaves four scalars of utils/CDC.py uninitialised -- they are part of this state dict, so inference from this checkpoint is deterministic.
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
